arabic text: PYAASI HU CHACHA JAAN, TADAPTI HU CHACHA JAAN\nSAKKAE YATIMA MUJHE PANI DO CHACHA JAAN
english translation text: I AM THIRSTY O BELOVED UNCLE, I AM IN AGONY MY BELOVED UNCLE\nTHE ONE WHO GIVES WATER TO ORPHANS, BRING ME SOME WATER O BELOVED UNCLE

arabic text: SAKKAE HARAM TUMKO YATIMOKI HAI KASSAM\nHO JAUNGI BEDAM MUJHE PANI DO CHACHA JAAN
english translation text: O WATER BEARER OF THE HOLY HOUSEHOLD, YOU HAVE THE HOPES OF ALL THE ORPHANS\nI WILL DIE OF THIRST, BRING ME SOME WATER O BELOVED UNCLE

arabic text: AY DUKHTARE IMAM MEI JATA HUN NEHR PAR\nABBASE ALAMDAR MUJHE PANI DO CHACHA JAAN
english translation text: O DAUGHTER OF THE IMAM, I AM GOING TO THE RIVERBANKS\nABBAS THE STANDARD BEARER, BRING ME SOME WATER O BELOVED UNCLE

arabic text: AY BABAJAAN MASHKE ALAM LEKE KYUN AYE\nBATLAO BABAJAAN KAHA MERE CHACHA JAAN
english translation text: O LOVING FATHER, WHY DID YOU BRING THE WATER BAG AND THE STANDARD OF THE ARMY\nTELL MY BELOVED FATHER, WHERE IS MY BELOVED UNCLE

arabic text: ROROKE PUCHTITI BALI SAKINA SABSE\nBABA TO ALAM LAYE CHACHA JAAN NAHI AAYE
english translation text: SAKINA WAS CRYING WHILE ASKING EVERYONE\nFATHER BROUGHT THE ALAM BACK, BUT MY UNCLE DIDN’T RETURN

arabic text: ABBAS NAAMDAAR TUJHE PYAASONKI HAI KASAM\nRAWZEPE BULALO SAKINAKE CHACHA JAAN
english translation text: ABBAS O STANDARD BEARER, YOU HAVE THE HOPES OF EVERYONE WHO IS THIRSTY\nCALL US TO THE SHRINE OF YOUR NIECE SAKINA, O HER LOVING UNCLE
